purpose: Direct source-class comparison under the relaxed thermal backbone: documented Magnicon second-order 10 kHz Bessel plus one shared pure zero versus the same documented Magnicon response plus one shared additive electronics-noise source injected downstream of the Magnicon filter and upstream of the known 100 kHz SIM965/sampling stage. c2=0 and c2-free are retained as references.

bypass_electronics_noise.semantics: One shared white ASD source that bypasses the Magnicon 10 kHz LPF but is still shaped by the known 100 kHz SIM965 response and first-alias fold. Existing post-filter white ASD remains independently profiled per day.

guardrail: This is a source-class discrimination diagnostic, not a component identification. The pure-zero branch tests a multiplicative minimum-phase zero-like response on top of the documented second-order Magnicon filter. The bypass branch tests one specific additive source location after the Magnicon 10 kHz LPF but before the fixed SIM965/sampling stage. A better branch only prioritizes the corresponding laboratory test: swept-signal transfer for multiplicative structure, or off-TES/reference electronics-noise measurements for an additive source.
